provenance.sourceState: Every file under apps/mobile and packages/core was at dba1097c7 except this harness: the card and React Native's own session controller still held their policy, and core had neither a panel model nor a controller.
provenance.device: AsyncStorage is the scenario's device: its stored session and fold switch, and a session read held until "release" when the scenario says hold. The clock is pinned to now.

scenarios.name: idle: start, pause, reset, switch, presets
finished focus: the line until reset
finished focus, linked task: Task done clears the line
link on: pick a task, mark it done, unlink
link on: no task to pick
link on: the linked task is gone
link off keeps a stored link hidden
